# GFM basics

Heading anchors appear on hover. This page covers everyday GitHub-Flavored Markdown.

## Emphasis and text

**Bold**, *italic*, ***both***, and ~~strikethrough~~. Inline `code` uses a
monospace face. Autolinks work: https://github.com/keathmilligan/gfm-hotview

Emoji shortcodes: :rocket: :sparkles: :file_folder: :memo: :warning:

## Lists

1. Ordered item
2. Nested:
   - Unordered
   - Another
3. Back to ordered

### Task list

- [x] Render GFM tables
- [x] Render task lists
- [ ] Ship the next feature

## Table

| Feature | GFM | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tables | yes | pipe syntax |
| Task lists | yes | `- [x]` |
| Footnotes | yes | `[^1]` |
| Strikethrough | yes | `~~text~~` |

## Quote and rule

> A plain blockquote is not an alert. Alerts live on [alerts.md](alerts.md).
